defect_found_and_fixed_during_this_pass.description: A '.'-scoped stage's input_fingerprint must be computed after that stage's own non-.vcps/ output (VCPS.md) already exists, not strictly before it -- vcps_tool.py's .vcps/ exclusion in expand_scope does not extend to VCPS.md itself, so a pre-output fingerprint makes every future resume check show that stage permanently stale.
defect_found_and_fixed_during_this_pass.classification: Methodology correction (how this fingerprint must be computed), not a vcps_tool.py code change -- consistent with how templates/validation.md already defines stage-output exclusion; vcps_tool.py's expand_scope was not modified in this pass.
